name: 19390 · West Grove, PA
findings: ZIP 19390 (West Grove) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19390 (West Grove) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19390 (West Grove) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
